description: web_submit_form finds the form whose controls include every scripted field, takes its action URL, method and live hidden fields from the page (a rotating __VIEWSTATE and CSRF token win over the recorded STARTHIDDENS values), overrides the scripted fields, and appends the image-button coordinates.
source: VuGen 26.1 Function Reference: web_submit_form (form identified by data fields, then Action, then Ordinal; hidden fields).

responses.body: <html><body><form name="search" action="search.pl"><input name="q"></form><form method="post" action="login.pl"><input type="hidden" name="__VIEWSTATE" value="VS-LIVE-7"><input type="hidden" name="csrf" value="CSRF-LIVE-7"><input name="username"><input type="password" name="password"><input type="image" name="login" src="login.gif"></form></body></html>
